findings.finding: Confirmed violation 1 remediation verified: resolvePrimaryRoot correctly uses 'git rev-parse --git-common-dir' and filepath.Dir to resolve the primary repository root from within any linked worktree or subdirectory. IsLinkedWorktree guard is relaxed only for read/ledger-only subcommands (feature status, defect record, defect list, defect decline), while git-mutating subcommands (feature create, feature destroy, reconcile approve/decline/cancel/renew/resolve, worktree cleanup, integrate retry) retain gitShowToplevel + IsLinkedWorktree guards.
findings.affects: ultrafixer-dispatch spec Requirement 'Independent two-axis evaluation and multi-branch triage'; defect-records spec Requirement 'Non-critical non-blocking defect persistence'

findings.finding: Confirmed violation 2 remediation verified: Ledger.UpdateDefectDisposition is implemented, validates dispositions via DefectDisposition.Valid, updates disposition and updated_at timestamp, and returns ErrDefectNotFound when rows affected is 0. The CLI subcommand 'lucind-ai defect decline --id <id>' is wired, and ultrafixer-packet-template.md:63 explicitly instructs human operators to record disposition=declined via this CLI path.
findings.affects: ultrafixer-dispatch spec Requirement 'Isolated repair delivery and human-gated CAS integration'

findings.finding: Non-blocking findings verified: (1) Packet template Tier label updated to 'Tier: B (human-gated CAS integration after audit)' removing contradiction; (2) Conventional commit and zero AI attribution / Co-Authored-By prohibition added to packet template and coordination docs; (3) TestUltrafixerPacketTemplateContract expanded to assert all protocol MUSTs; (4) CLI-level --disposition flag validation implemented with explicit error message; (5) Plugin manifest versions bumped to 2.0.6 across marketplace.json, plugin.json, and skill_content_hash.txt.

findings.finding: No regressions detected: Schema v8 migrations, RecordDefect, GetDefect, ListDefects, and CLI subcommands defect record and defect list continue to operate correctly with clean separation between ledger mutations and git worktree isolation.

Test quality verified: TestLinkedWorktreeCommands in cmd/lucind-ai/cli_test.go creates a real git repository and a real linked worktree on disk (worktree.Create), changes directory into the linked worktree (os.Chdir), invokes feature status, defect list, defect record, and defect decline from inside the linked worktree, and inspects the real SQLite database rows in the primary repository without mocks or stubs.
